alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 7 at 2:02AM PST until November 8 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Island County, Lowlands of Western Skagit and Northwestern
Snohomish Counties, Lowlands of Western Whatcom County, Port
Townsend Area, San Juan County, City of Seattle, Downtown Everett /
Marysville Area, Eastside, Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King
Counties, and Shoreline / Lynnwood / South Everett Area.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 4 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.
